<b>Garb of the Pilgrims</b> is a [[Hunt Wishes|Hunt Wish]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>, started by accepting from the Wishwall in [[Bone Bottom]], which becomes available after the [[Bell Beast]] is defeated. As Bone Bottom is destroyed in Act 3, this Wish is removed from the [[Tasks]] menu if uncompleted.

== Wish ==
[[File:Pilgrim Shawl.png|link=Pilgrim Shawl|left|thumb|100x100px]]

The residents of Bone Bottom request 12 [[Pilgrim Shawl]]s from [[Haunting|Haunted]] Pilgrims throughout [[Pharloom]].

They can be obtained from any enemy with "Pilgrim" in their name, but they are most plentiful in [[Mosshome]] due to its large groups of pilgrim enemies. Shawls do <b>not</b> drop during enemy gauntlets.

Additionally, upon breaking bags containing Pilgrim corpses in the east [[Bench]] room in [[Bilewater]], corpses drop that have collectable shawls.

A shawl can also be collected from the corpse of a [[Pilgrim Groveller]] within a glass display at the exhibits section of the [[Memorium]]. This shawl can be repeatedly taken if [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] renters the room and breaks the glass display again.

== Reward ==
[[File:Rosary Necklace.png|link=Rosary Necklace|left|thumb|100x100px]]

After completing the quest, a [[Rosary Necklace]] is rewarded, worth {{R|120}}. A clothesline draped with Pilgrim Shawls is added to the background in Bone Bottom.
